head: Opera One on iPhone adds Data Saver, cutting data use up to 80%
dek: Opera's browser for iPhone now has Data Saver, which compresses images and text on Opera's servers before they reach your phone; Opera says it can cut data use by up to 80%.
details: Opera also said its monthly iPhone users grew 20% in a year, and 46% in the US.
means: On a small data plan or slow connection, pages can load with less data.
todo: Turn on Data Saver in Opera One's settings when you're on mobile data.
